model_interpretation.claim: At the current 192-thread CTA/tile setting, replacing 28-byte staged Particle records with 16-byte source records reduces dynamic shared memory from 5,376 to 3,072 bytes while retaining the same one-target-per-thread mapping, source order, and barriers. items.subject: Shared-memory source tiling with one target per thread
items.objective: Explore CTA-level shared-memory tiling of source particles, with exactly one target per thread and no multi-target coarsening. Use a consistent mapping such as items_per_block=block, stage source tiles, and handle partial tiles and output bounds. Keep shared-memory use within the allowed limit. Compare staging costs and benefits under the official protocol; pass all correctness checks before timing. Work only in src/nbody_kernel.cu and src/launch.json.
